id: title:carlos-marchal-ph:don t fail evals on unparsable judge output

review.posthog_relevance: Updates the AI evaluation backend and frontend to support a new outcome-based result shape, replacing the previous two-field applicable/verdict structure with a single outcome field and adding support for skipped evaluation status.
review.reason: The change replaces a two-field model structure with a single outcome field and updates the backend and frontend to support this new shape and skipped status. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and compatibility improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the skipped status or skip reason, only the test and UI display, which limits the ability to assess the full implementation and its reliability. The tier assignment is based on the backend and frontend changes, not the skipped status implementation.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds Annotated and BeforeValidator to typing and pydantic imports; removes BaseModel, model_validator; adds Usage to LLM backend imports.

observations.posthog_connection: Replaces the two-field applicable/verdict shape with a single outcome field, removing the need for a model-level consistency check and supporting the provider's JSON Schema and Anthropic's lack of enum enforcement.
